The RedirectSlashes middleware from go-chi/chi is not registered in any of the influxdb v2 HTTP routers. Chi is used extensively for routing but RedirectSlashes is never called, so the open redirect code path cannot be triggered.

The vulnerability in GHSA-cq8v-f236-94qc affects rand::rng(), an API introduced in rand 0.9.0. rand@0.8.5 does not contain this function and is not affected. The affected ranges are >=0.9.0,<0.9.3 and >=0.10.0,<0.10.1 only.

The advisory (GHSA-mqqf-5wvp-8fh8) covers github.com/go-chi/chi/v5, which is a distinct Go module from github.com/go-chi/chi (v4). The v4 module does not contain the vulnerable RedirectSlashes code path introduced in the v5 rewrite. Scanner match against the v4 module path is a false positive.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
